kind.description: What the document is. A credit note subtracts, but its amounts stay positive.

supplier_name.description: The name of the supplier: the party that issued the document, not the one it is addressed to.

supplier_registration_number.description: The company registration number of the supplier, as printed.

supplier_vat_id.description: The VAT identification number of the supplier, as printed, with its country prefix.

supplier_country.description: The country of the supplier as two capital letters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example "DE").

supplier_number.description: The number of the document as the supplier issued it.

variable_symbol.description: The variable symbol or payment reference printed on the document.

issue_date.description: The date the document was issued as YYYY-MM-DD.

tax_point_date.description: The date of the taxable supply as YYYY-MM-DD.

due_date.description: The date the payment is due as YYYY-MM-DD.

currency.description: The currency of the amounts as three capital letters (ISO 4217, for example "EUR").

total.description: The total amount to pay including VAT, as a decimal string with a point and at most two decimals, never negative (no minus sign, even on a credit note), without a currency sign or a thousands separator (for example "1210.50").

rate.description: The VAT rate as a percent number without a percent sign (for example "21" or "0").

base.description: The taxable base of this rate, as a decimal string with a point and at most two decimals, never negative (no minus sign, even on a credit note), without a currency sign or a thousands separator (for example "1210.50").

vat.description: The VAT amount of this rate, as a decimal string with a point and at most two decimals, never negative (no minus sign, even on a credit note), without a currency sign or a thousands separator (for example "1210.50").

vat_recap.description: The VAT summary: one row per VAT rate. Null when the document prints none.

bank_account.description: The bank account the supplier asks to be paid to: an IBAN, or a domestic number in the form prefix-number/bank code.
